##### Ağzanyñ orta özgerısıne jauabyn boljau

[predictAnOrganismsResponseToEnvironmentalChange.ts](../../../data/skills/ecology/habitats/predictAnOrganismsResponseToEnvironmentalChange.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Predict how a change in available resources or temperature will alter the behavior, growth, or survival of a species.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Resurstar ne temperatura özgerse, türge qalai äser etuı mümkın ekenın bolja.

##### Ağzanyñ qūrylysyn orta jağdailarymen bailanystyru

[relateOrganismStructureToEnvironmentalConditions.ts](../../../data/skills/ecology/habitats/relateOrganismStructureToEnvironmentalConditions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain, at the level of ecological niches, how organisms’ structures affect resource use and survival under particular environmental factors. Unlike botanical analysis of individual plant organs, this competency assesses how an organism fits its environment and ecological role.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ağzanyñ qūrylysy ortada tırı qalyp, resurstardy paidalanuğa qalai kömektesetının tüsındır.

#### Ağzalardyñ özara ärekettesuı

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/ecology/interactionsAmongOrganisms/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Organisms may use one another as resources, compete, or benefit one another; the nature of an interaction is determined by its consequences for those involved.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ağzalar qalai bäsekelesetının, bır-bırımen qorektenetının nemese yntymaqtasatynyn zertte.

##### Türler ärekettesuındegı tozañdandyrğyştardyñ rölın tüsındıru

[explainTheRoleOfPollinatorsInSpeciesInteractions.ts](../../../data/skills/ecology/interactionsAmongOrganisms/explainTheRoleOfPollinatorsInSpeciesInteractions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how an animal’s transfer of pollen relates to plant reproduction and to the pollinator’s resources.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tozañdandyrğyştar men güldı ösımdıkter bır-bırıne qalai täueldı ekenın tüsındır.

##### Bäsekelestıktı tanu

[recognizeCompetition.ts](../../../data/skills/ecology/interactionsAmongOrganisms/recognizeCompetition.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize situations in which limited food, light, or territory reduces resource availability to others.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ağzalardyñ şekteulı resurstar üşın bäsekelesu mysaldaryn anyqta.

##### Özara paidaly qatynastardy tanu

[recognizeMutuallyBeneficialRelationships.ts](../../../data/skills/ecology/interactionsAmongOrganisms/recognizeMutuallyBeneficialRelationships.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify interactions that increase the fitness of both species rather than only one.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qatysuşy ekı türge de paida äkeletın qatynastardy anyqta.

##### Jyrtqyştyqty tanu

[recognizePredation.ts](../../../data/skills/ecology/interactionsAmongOrganisms/recognizePredation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish consumption of one organism by another from competition over a shared resource.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bır ağza basqa ağzany ūstap, onymen qorektenetın jağdailardy anyqta.

### Jalpy jäne jasuşa biologiasy

Groups: 4 · Skills: 15

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/generalAndCellBiology/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Shared principles of cellular organism organization, from the cell to interactions among organs, as well as metabolism, growth, and responses. Specific human systems and particular taxa are addressed in their respective Domains.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jasuşalar men ağza qūrylymdarynyñ tırşılık üderısterın qoldau üşın qalai bırlesıp jūmys ısteitının zertte.

#### Jasuşanyñ bölınuı

Skills: 2

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/generalAndCellBiology/cellDivision/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The cell cycle involves division of genetic material and cytoplasm; mitosis supports growth and tissue renewal, while meiosis is associated with sexual reproduction and inherited variation.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jasuşalardyñ bölınuı ösuge, jañaruğa jäne köbeiuge qalai kömektesetının bıl.

##### Meiozdy tüsındıru

[explainMeiosis.ts](../../../data/skills/generalAndCellBiology/cellDivision/explainMeiosis.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain successive divisions following a single round of DNA replication, the halving of chromosome number, recombination, and independent chromosome assortment. Distinguish meiotic products in animals and plants: in plants, meiosis may produce spores rather than gametes directly.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Meioz hromosoma sany az jasuşalardy qalai tüzetının jäne genetikalyq özgergıştıkke qalai äkeletının bıl.

##### Mitozdy tüsındıru

[explainMitosis.ts](../../../data/skills/generalAndCellBiology/cellDivision/explainMitosis.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain division of a eukaryotic cell nucleus while maintaining the chromosome number and distributing replicated DNA between daughter nuclei. Distinguish mitosis from cytokinesis and explain its roles in growth, tissue renewal, and asexual reproduction.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Mitoz kezınde genetikalyq materialdyñ enşıles iadrolar arasynda qalai bölınetının zertte.

#### Jasuşa qūrylysy

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/generalAndCellBiology/cellularStructure/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Cells have membranes and internal components that sustain life processes; diagrams help reveal commonalities and differences among different cells.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jasuşalardyñ neden tūratynyn jäne olardyñ qūrylymdary qalai jūmys ısteuge kömektesetının bıl.

##### Qūrylymyna qarai ösımdık jäne januar jasuşalaryn ajyratu

[distinguishPlantAndAnimalCellsByStructuralFeatures.ts](../../../data/skills/generalAndCellBiology/cellularStructure/distinguishPlantAndAnimalCellsByStructuralFeatures.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish characteristic cell features: the cell wall and plastids in plant cells and the absence of these structures in animal cells. Do not assume that all plant cells contain chloroplasts (many root cells, for instance, do not). An illustration, a textual description, or an interactive model are alternative ways of assessing the competency, not part of the Skill name.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Barlyq jasuşa bırdei körınedı dep oilamai, ösımdık pen januar jasuşalarynyñ negızgı belgılerın tany.

##### Bırjasuşaly jäne köpjasuşaly ağzalardy ajyratu

[distinguishUnicellularAndMulticellularOrganisms.ts](../../../data/skills/generalAndCellBiology/cellularStructure/distinguishUnicellularAndMulticellularOrganisms.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether a single cell carries out all functions of an organism or many specialized cells work together.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bır jasuşadan tūratyn ağzalardy köptegen mamandanğan jasuşalardan tūratyn ağzalardan ajyrat.

##### Jasuşany qūrylymdyq bırlık retınde tanu

[recognizeTheCellAsAStructuralUnit.ts](../../../data/skills/generalAndCellBiology/cellularStructure/recognizeTheCellAsAStructuralUnit.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Understand that the tissues and bodies of cellular organisms consist of microscopic units, each with its own boundary.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jasuşalardyñ tırı ağzalardyñ negızgı qūrylymdyq bırlıkterı ekenın tüsın.

##### Jasuşanyñ negızgı qūrylymdaryn olardyñ qyzmetterımen bailanystyru

[relateMajorCellStructuresToTheirFunctions.ts](../../../data/skills/generalAndCellBiology/cellularStructure/relateMajorCellStructuresToTheirFunctions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Associate the membrane with selective exchange, the nucleus with genetic information, and other depicted organelles with their main cellular functions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jasuşa ışındegı qūrylymdardy olardyñ atqaratyn qyzmetterımen bailanystyr.

#### Ūiymdasu deñgeilerı

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/generalAndCellBiology/levelsOfOrganization/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Parts of cellular organisms form nested levels; the functioning of a whole depends on the coordinated work of its structures.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jasuşalar, ūlpalar, müşeler jäne müşeler jüielerı tırı ağzalarda qalai bailanysatynyn zertte.

##### Ağzanyñ bölıgın tūtas ağzadan ajyratu

[distinguishAPartOfAnOrganismFromAWholeOrganism.ts](../../../data/skills/generalAndCellBiology/levelsOfOrganization/distinguishAPartOfAnOrganismFromAWholeOrganism.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the boundary between an individual organ, a part of that organ, and an organism as an independent living system.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jeke müşenı nemese dene bölıgın tūtas tırı ağzadan ajyrat.

##### Ağzadağy müşenıñ qyzmetın tüsındıru

[explainAnOrgansFunctionInAnOrganism.ts](../../../data/skills/generalAndCellBiology/levelsOfOrganization/explainAnOrgansFunctionInAnOrganism.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how a particular structure contributes to overall life processes, such as absorbing or transporting substances.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Belgılı bır müşe bükıl ağzanyñ jūmysyna qalai kömektesetının tüsındır.

##### Müşelerdıñ özara täueldılıgın tüsındıru

[explainTheInterdependenceOfOrgans.ts](../../../data/skills/generalAndCellBiology/levelsOfOrganization/explainTheInterdependenceOfOrgans.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Show why a disruption in one system can alter the functioning of another.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ärtürlı müşelerdıñ bır-bırıne nege täueldı ekenın zertte.

##### Jasuşa, ūlpa, müşe jäne jüie deñgeilerın retteu

[orderTheLevelsCellTissueOrganSystem.ts](../../../data/skills/generalAndCellBiology/levelsOfOrganization/orderTheLevelsCellTissueOrganSystem.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Establish how cells form tissues, tissues form organs, and organs can work together within a system.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jasuşalardy, ūlpalardy, müşelerdı jäne müşeler jüielerın ūiymdasu deñgeilerı boiynşa rette.

#### Tırşılık üderısterı

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/generalAndCellBiology/lifeProcesses/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Exchange of matter and energy, increases in size, changes in form, and responses to conditions are manifestations of life that can be observed or modeled.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ağzalardyñ resurstardy qalai alatynyn, ösetının jäne qorşağan ortağa jauap beretının bıl.

##### Jasuşalyq tynys aludy tüsındıru

[explainCellularRespiration.ts](../../../data/skills/generalAndCellBiology/lifeProcesses/explainCellularRespiration.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how cells obtain usable energy by breaking down organic compounds while synthesizing ATP. Distinguish aerobic and anaerobic pathways, and do not equate cellular respiration with lung ventilation or gas exchange in respiratory organs.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jasuşalardyñ organikalyq zattardan qoldanuğa bolatyn energiany qalai böletının bıl.

##### Fotosintezdı tüsındıru

[explainPhotosynthesis.ts](../../../data/skills/generalAndCellBiology/lifeProcesses/explainPhotosynthesis.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the conversion of light energy into chemical energy as photosynthetic organisms form organic substances from carbon dioxide and water; identify the roles of chloroplasts and pigments and the release of oxygen during oxygenic photosynthesis. Do not equate photosynthesis with mineral nutrition or respiration.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Fotosintez jasaityn ağzalardyñ jaryq arqyly organikalyq zattardy qalai tüzetının tüsındır.

##### Qorektenu mysaldaryn tanu

[identifyExamplesOfNutrition.ts](../../../data/skills/generalAndCellBiology/lifeProcesses/identifyExamplesOfNutrition.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the acquisition and use of nutrients by organisms as nutrition, distinguishing forms of nutrition across different organisms.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ağzalardyñ qorektık zattardy aluy men paidalanuynyñ ärtürlı joldaryn tany.

##### Ösu men damudy tanu

[recognizeGrowthAndDevelopment.ts](../../../data/skills/generalAndCellBiology/lifeProcesses/recognizeGrowthAndDevelopment.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish increases in mass or size from changes in structure and function during transitions between life stages.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kölemınıñ ūlğaiuyn ağzanyñ qūrylysy men qyzmetınıñ özgeruınen ajyrat.

##### Tıtırkendırgışterge jauaptardy tanu

[recognizeResponsesToStimuli.ts](../../../data/skills/generalAndCellBiology/lifeProcesses/recognizeResponsesToStimuli.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Establish how light, touch, or a chemical signal elicits a change in an organism’s state or movement.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tırı ağzalardyñ jaryqqa, janasuğa jäne basqa signaldarğa qalai jauap beretının tany.

### Genetika jäne evoliutsia

Groups: 3 · Skills: 17

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/geneticsAndEvolution/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Transmission of hereditary information, reasons for similarities and differences among offspring, and changes in inherited traits within populations across generations. An individual's growth is not an evolutionary process.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tūqymqualauşylyq aqparat ūrpaqtan ūrpaqqa qalai berıletının jäne populiatsialar qalai evoliutsialanatynyn zertte.

#### Evoliutsialyq özgerıster

Skills: 8

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/geneticsAndEvolution/evolutionaryChanges/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Hereditary variation and differences in reproductive success alter the prevalence of traits in populations across generations; this is not the same as development of an individual organism.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Populiatsialardağy tūqym qualaityn özgergıştık ūrpaqtar boiy qalai özgeretının bıl.

##### Jeke ağzanyñ ömırındegı özgerısterdı populiatsia özgerısterınen ajyratu

[distinguishIndividualChangesDuringLifeFromPopulationChanges.ts](../../../data/skills/geneticsAndEvolution/evolutionaryChanges/distinguishIndividualChangesDuringLifeFromPopulationChanges.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish changes in the growth or behavior of one individual from changes in the frequencies of inherited traits in a population.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bır ağzanyñ ömırındegı özgerısterdı populiatsialardyñ bırneşe ūrpaq boiyndağy evoliutsiasynan ajyrat.

##### Türlerdıñ ortaq ata-tegın tüsındıru

[explainCommonAncestryOfSpecies.ts](../../../data/skills/geneticsAndEvolution/evolutionaryChanges/explainCommonAncestryOfSpecies.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain that different species may descend from common ancestors and that an evolutionary tree represents branching lineages; distinguish a common ancestor from a modern species supposedly transforming directly into another.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ärtürlı türlerdıñ tarmaqtalğan evoliutsialyq tarihta ortaq ata-tegı qalai boluy mümkın ekenın tüsındır.

##### Daralar arasyndağy tūqymqualaityn özgergıştıktı tüsındıru

[explainHereditaryVariationAmongIndividuals.ts](../../../data/skills/geneticsAndEvolution/evolutionaryChanges/explainHereditaryVariationAmongIndividuals.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate differences that may be inherited to diversity among individuals and the possibility of population change.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Daralar arasynda tūqym qualaityn aiyrmaşylyqtar nege bolatynyn tüsındır.

##### Evoliutsialyq özgerıs mehanizmderın tüsındıru

[explainMechanismsOfEvolutionaryChange.ts](../../../data/skills/geneticsAndEvolution/evolutionaryChanges/explainMechanismsOfEvolutionaryChange.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish mutation, natural selection, genetic drift, and gene flow as processes that alter the inherited composition of populations; explain their distinct roles and potential combined action without reducing all evolutionary change to selection.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Mutatsiany, tabiği sūryptaludy, genetikalyq dreiftı jäne gen ağynyn evoliutsianyñ sebepterı retınde salystyr.

##### Tabiği sūryptaludy tüsındıru

[explainNaturalSelection.ts](../../../data/skills/geneticsAndEvolution/evolutionaryChanges/explainNaturalSelection.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how inherited differences in survival and reproductive success change the frequencies of hereditary variants in a population over generations; selection is neither a conscious choice by organisms nor progress toward predetermined perfection.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tabiği sūryptalu ūrpaqtar boiy populiatsiadağy tūqym qualaityn belgılerdıñ jiılıgın qalai özgerte alatynyn tüsın.

##### Jaña türlerdıñ qalyptasuyn tüsındıru

[explainSpeciation.ts](../../../data/skills/geneticsAndEvolution/evolutionaryChanges/explainSpeciation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how hereditary variation, population divergence, restricted gene flow, and reproductive isolation may give rise to new species; recognize that mechanisms of speciation differ among groups of organisms.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Populiatsialar bırtındep alşaqtap, jaña türlerdı qalai tüze alatynyn bıl.

##### Evoliutsia teoriasyn tüsındıru

[explainTheTheoryOfEvolution.ts](../../../data/skills/geneticsAndEvolution/evolutionaryChanges/explainTheTheoryOfEvolution.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain modern evolutionary theory as a scientific explanation of changes in inherited population characteristics and the diversity of life, supported by multiple converging lines of evidence. Distinguish a scientific theory from individual hypotheses, factual observations, and claims of purpose-directed development.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Evoliutsiany ärtürlı däleldermen rastalğan ğylymi tüsındırme retınde tüsın.

##### Evoliutsia dälelderın tüsındıru

[interpretEvidenceOfEvolution.ts](../../../data/skills/geneticsAndEvolution/evolutionaryChanges/interpretEvidenceOfEvolution.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain convergent evidence for life's history from fossils, comparative anatomy, biogeography, embryology, and molecular data, taking into account the limitations of each type of evidence.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qazba qaldyqtar, anatomia jäne DNQ evoliutsianyñ dälelderın qalai beretının zertte.

#### Genetika

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/geneticsAndEvolution/genetics/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Genes, as segments of hereditary information, help explain relatedness and differences; how a trait is expressed also depends on regulation and the environment.

**User-friendly description (kk):** DNQ, gender jäne olardyñ belsendılıgı tūqym qualaityn belgılerge qalai äser etetının bıl.

##### Gendı belgıden ajyratu

[distinguishAGeneFromATrait.ts](../../../data/skills/geneticsAndEvolution/genetics/distinguishAGeneFromATrait.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain that a gene is a segment of hereditary information, while an observable trait results from its activity and environmental influences.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Gendı ol äser etuı mümkın körınetın belgıden ajyrat.

##### Genetikalyq aqparattyñ ekspressiasyn tüsındıru

[explainExpressionOfGeneticInformation.ts](../../../data/skills/geneticsAndEvolution/genetics/explainExpressionOfGeneticInformation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how DNA information can be transcribed into RNA and realized through protein synthesis and regulation of gene activity; do not equate an individual gene with a ready-made phenotypic trait.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jasuşalar DNQ aqparatyn qalai qoldanyp, onyñ ıske asuyn qalai retteitının bıl.

##### Belgılerdıñ tūqymqualau mehanizmderın tüsındıru

[explainMechanismsOfTraitInheritance.ts](../../../data/skills/geneticsAndEvolution/genetics/explainMechanismsOfTraitInheritance.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the roles of genes, alleles, and chromosomes, segregation of alleles, and formation of their combinations in offspring. Apply Mendelian patterns where appropriate and distinguish them from polygenic and environmentally influenced traits.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Gender men olardyñ nūsqalary ūrpaqtan ūrpaqqa qalai berıletının zertte.

##### Tūqymqualauşylyq aqparattyñ berıluın tüsındıru

[explainTransmissionOfHereditaryInformation.ts](../../../data/skills/geneticsAndEvolution/genetics/explainTransmissionOfHereditaryInformation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how DNA is copied and distributed during cell division and passed between generations through sex cells or asexual reproduction. Distinguish transmission of molecular information from its expression in observable traits.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tūqymqualauşylyq aqparat qalai köşırılıp, keiın berıletının tüsın.

##### Tūqymqualauşylyq aqparatty saqtaudağy DNQ rölın tanu

[recognizeDNAsRoleInStoringHereditaryInformation.ts](../../../data/skills/geneticsAndEvolution/genetics/recognizeDNAsRoleInStoringHereditaryInformation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the role of DNA sequences in storing information about the construction and regulation of cellular structures.

**User-friendly description (kk):** DNQ tırı jasuşalar qoldanatyn aqparatty qalai saqtaitynyn tüsındır.

#### Köbeiu jäne belgıler

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/geneticsAndEvolution/reproductionAndTraits/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Inherited characteristics can recur in offspring, but individuals of one species are not exact copies; reproductive mode affects variation.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ūrpaqtary tuystaryna nege ūqsaitynyn, bıraq ärdaiym bırdei bolmaitynyn bıl.

##### Tūqym qualaityn jäne jüre paida bolğan belgılerdı ajyratu

[distinguishHereditaryAndAcquiredTraits.ts](../../../data/skills/geneticsAndEvolution/reproductionAndTraits/distinguishHereditaryAndAcquiredTraits.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish changes that can be passed to offspring through genetic information from changes acquired by an individual through experience, injury, or training. Explain that most phenotypic traits arise from interactions between genotype and environment, so a rigid binary classification is not universally applicable.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Gender men orta belgılerge qalai bırlesıp äser etetının zertte, olardy qatañ ekıge bölme.

##### Jynysty jäne jynyssyz köbeiudı ajyratu

[distinguishSexualAndAsexualReproduction.ts](../../../data/skills/geneticsAndEvolution/reproductionAndTraits/distinguishSexualAndAsexualReproduction.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish the fusion of sex cells from reproduction without their fusion, regardless of how offspring outwardly appear.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jynys jasuşalary qosylatyn jäne qosylmaityn köbeiudı ajyrat.

##### Bır tür ūrpaqtarynyñ aiyrmaşylyğyn tüsındıru

[explainDifferencesAmongOffspringOfTheSameSpecies.ts](../../../data/skills/geneticsAndEvolution/reproductionAndTraits/explainDifferencesAmongOffspringOfTheSameSpecies.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why recombination, mutations, and developmental conditions can produce differences among individuals.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bır türge jatatyn daralarda nege ärtürlı belgıler qalyptasuy mümkın ekenın tüsındır.

##### Mysaldardan tūqym qualaityn belgılerdı tanu

[identifyHereditaryTraitsInExamples.ts](../../../data/skills/geneticsAndEvolution/reproductionAndTraits/identifyHereditaryTraitsInExamples.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify similarities between generations associated with the transmission of genetic information.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ata-analar men ūrpaqtar mysalynan tūqym qualaityn belgılerdı anyqta.

### Adam anatomiasy men fiziologiasy

Groups: 6 · Skills: 24

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The structure of the body, organ functions, and interactions among systems that allow humans to move, perceive, breathe, and sustain life. Rules of hygiene, first aid, and safe behavior belong to a separate textbook.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Adam denesınıñ qūrylymdary men müşeler jüielerı tırşılıktı saqtau üşın qalai bırlesıp jūmys ısteitının zertteñız.

#### Dene qūrylysy

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/bodyStructure/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** External and internal body parts form organs and systems, each performing a particular function in the organism.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Dene bölıkterı, müşeler men müşeler jüielerı qalai bırıgetının bılıñız.

##### Müşe men müşeler jüiesın ajyratu

[distinguishAnOrganFromAnOrganSystem.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/bodyStructure/distinguishAnOrganFromAnOrganSystem.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish a single anatomical structure from a functional association of several organs.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jeke müşenı bırıgıp jūmys ısteitın müşeler jüiesınen ajyratyñyz.

##### Denenıñ negızgı bölıkterın anyqtau

[identifyMajorBodyParts.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/bodyStructure/identifyMajorBodyParts.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Locate the head, trunk, limbs, and important external structures on a model of the human body.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Adam denesınıñ negızgı syrtqy bölıkterın tanyñyz.

##### Müşelerdı qyzmetterımen bailanystyru

[relateOrgansToTheirFunctions.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/bodyStructure/relateOrgansToTheirFunctions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Associate the lungs with gas exchange, the heart with blood movement, and the stomach and intestines with food processing.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ökpe, jürek jäne ışek siaqty müşelerdı qyzmetterımen säikestendırıñız.

#### Ağzanyñ damuy men qorğanysy

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/developmentAndProtectionOfTheOrganism/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Changes from childhood to adulthood, immune mechanisms, and physiological recovery help maintain bodily functions over time.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Damu, immundyq qorğanys pen qalpyna kelu ağza qyzmetın qalai saqtaitynyn zertteñız.

##### Adam damuynyñ kezeñderın ajyratu

[distinguishStagesOfHumanDevelopment.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/developmentAndProtectionOfTheOrganism/distinguishStagesOfHumanDevelopment.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate observable growth and pubertal changes to the main stages of human life, without making normative judgments about a 'correct' developmental pace.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ärkım bırdei qarqynmen damidy dep oilamai, adam damuynyñ kezeñderın tanyñyz.

##### Adamnyñ köbeiu jüiesınıñ qyzmetterın tüsındıru

[explainFunctionsOfTheHumanReproductiveSystem.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/developmentAndProtectionOfTheOrganism/explainFunctionsOfTheHumanReproductiveSystem.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the biological functions of reproductive organs, production of sex cells, and the role of fertilization in human sexual reproduction, distinguishing physiological facts from individual differences in development.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Adamnyñ köbeiu müşelerı men üderısterınıñ biologialyq qyzmetterın tüsınıñız.

##### İmmundyq jüienıñ qorğanys rölın tüsındıru

[explainTheImmuneSystemsProtectiveRole.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/developmentAndProtectionOfTheOrganism/explainTheImmuneSystemsProtectiveRole.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how the body recognizes foreign agents and initiates a protective response without confusing this with absolute protection against disease.

**User-friendly description (kk):** İmmundyq jüienıñ yqtimal ziandy faktorlardy qalai tanyp, olarğa jauap beretının tüsındırıñız.

##### Ūiqynyñ qalpyna keludegı mañyzyn tüsındıru

[explainTheImportanceOfSleepForRecovery.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/developmentAndProtectionOfTheOrganism/explainTheImportanceOfSleepForRecovery.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate sleep to neural regulation, memory, and restoration of functions without replacing explanations of mechanisms with rules about sleep schedules.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ūiqy mi qyzmetın, este saqtaudy jäne qalpyna keludı qalai qoldaitynyn bılıñız.

#### Tırşılık üderısterın qamtamasyz etu

Skills: 8

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/maintainingLifeProcesses/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Nutrients, oxygen, and blood travel along different pathways; their coordinated operation provides cells with resources.

**User-friendly description (kk):** As qorytu, tynys alu jäne qan ainalymy dene jasuşalaryn qalai qamtamasyz etetının zertteñız.

##### Qorektık zattardyñ qorytyluyn tüsındıru

[explainDigestionOfNutrients.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/maintainingLifeProcesses/explainDigestionOfNutrients.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the mechanical and enzymatic processing of food in the digestive tract and the role of digestive juices in breaking large molecules into components available for absorption.

**User-friendly description (kk):** As qorytu tağamdy ağza paidalana alatyn ūsaq zattarğa qalai ydyratatynyn bılıñız.

##### Ökpedegı gaz almasudy tüsındıru

[explainGasExchangeInTheLungs.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/maintainingLifeProcesses/explainGasExchangeInTheLungs.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the exchange of oxygen and carbon dioxide between the alveoli and blood.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ökpe alveolalaryndağy aua men qan arasynda ottegı men kömırqyşqyl gazy qalai almasatynyn tüsınıñız.

##### Ökpe jeldetıluın tüsındıru

[explainLungVentilation.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/maintainingLifeProcesses/explainLungVentilation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain inhalation and exhalation as air movement caused by respiratory muscle activity, changes in thoracic cavity volume, and pressure differences; distinguish ventilation from alveolar gas exchange and cellular respiration.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tynys alu būlşyqetterı auany ökpege qalai engızıp, qaita şyğaratynyn tüsındırıñız.

##### Qorektık zattardyñ sıñuın tüsındıru

[explainNutrientAbsorption.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/maintainingLifeProcesses/explainNutrientAbsorption.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how digestive products pass through the intestinal epithelium into blood and lymph; distinguish chemical digestion from transport of already broken-down nutrients.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qorytylğan qorektık zattardyñ ışekten ağzağa qalai sıñetının bılıñız.

##### Jürektıñ qan ainalymyndağy rölın tüsındıru

[explainTheHeartsRoleInCirculation.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/maintainingLifeProcesses/explainTheHeartsRoleInCirculation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe the heart as a pump that drives blood through vessels to organs and back.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jürek qandy bükıl denege qalai aidaitynyn zertteñız.

##### Tağamnyñ as qorytu jüiesı arqyly ötuın tüsındıru

[explainThePassageOfFoodThroughTheDigestiveSystem.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/maintainingLifeProcesses/explainThePassageOfFoodThroughTheDigestiveSystem.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the sequential passage of food through the mouth, esophagus, stomach, and intestines, the role of peristalsis, and the difference between food movement, digestion, and nutrient absorption.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tağamnyñ as qorytu jolyndağy bağytyn baqylap, türlı qyzmetterın ajyratyñyz.

##### Büirektıñ bölıp şyğarudağy rölın tüsındıru

[explainTheRoleOfTheKidneysInExcretion.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/maintainingLifeProcesses/explainTheRoleOfTheKidneysInExcretion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain blood filtration, selective reabsorption of water and needed substances, and urine formation as means of removing metabolic waste and maintaining the internal environment.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Büirek qandy qalai süzıp, ağzanyñ ışkı tepe-teñdıgın saqtauğa kömektesetının tüsındırıñız.

##### Dene belsendılıgı kezındegı tynys alu özgerısterın anyqtau

[identifyBreathingChangesDuringPhysicalActivity.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/maintainingLifeProcesses/identifyBreathingChangesDuringPhysicalActivity.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate faster and deeper breathing to the increased need of working muscles for oxygen and removal of CO₂.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Dene belsendılıgı kezınde tynys alu nege özgeretının tüsındırıñız.

#### Rettelu jäne gomeostaz

Skills: 2

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/regulationAndHomeostasis/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Nervous and hormonal signals coordinate organ functions, while feedback mechanisms maintain key internal conditions within viable ranges.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Gormondar, jüikeler men kerı bailanys ağza qyzmetterın qalai retteitının zertteñız.

##### Endokrindık retteludı tüsındıru

[explainEndocrineRegulation.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/regulationAndHomeostasis/explainEndocrineRegulation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how hormones secreted by endocrine glands affect cells and organs, including metabolism, growth, and responses to environmental changes; compare the duration of hormonal and neural signals without claiming that these always act independently.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Gormondardyñ ösu men ağzanyñ özge üderısterıne äser etetın signaldardy qalai jetkızetının zertteñız.

##### Gomeostazdy saqtaudy tüsındıru

[explainMaintenanceOfHomeostasis.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/regulationAndHomeostasis/explainMaintenanceOfHomeostasis.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how temperature, water balance, and blood glucose are maintained through regulation and negative feedback; distinguish dynamic stability of the internal environment from a total absence of change.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ağza ışkı jağdailaryn qolaily aralyqta qalai saqtaitynyn tüsınıñız.

#### Sezım müşelerı men jüike jüiesı

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/sensoryOrgansAndTheNervousSystem/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Receptors detect different stimuli, the nervous system processes signals, and the skin also protects the body as a physical barrier.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sezım müşelerı men jüikeler aqparatty qalai qabyldap, jauap beretının zertteñız.

##### Tıtırkendırgışterge jauapty tüsındıru

[explainResponsesToStimuli.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/sensoryOrgansAndTheNervousSystem/explainResponsesToStimuli.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how a sensory signal can trigger a muscle response or a change in behavior.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qabyldanğan aqparattyñ qozğalys ne mınez-qūlyq özgerısın qalai tudyratynyn zertteñız.

##### Terınıñ qorğanys qyzmetın anyqtau

[identifyTheSkinsProtectiveFunction.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/sensoryOrgansAndTheNervousSystem/identifyTheSkinsProtectiveFunction.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how intact skin reduces water loss and the penetration of harmful agents.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sau, zaqymdanbağan terı denenı qalai qorğap, sudyñ joğaluyn azaitatynyn bılıñız.

##### Midyñ qabyldaudağy rölın tanu

[recognizeTheBrainsRoleInPerception.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/sensoryOrgansAndTheNervousSystem/recognizeTheBrainsRoleInPerception.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Understand that nerve signals from the sense organs are processed in the brain rather than being turned into conscious sensations by the eyes or ears themselves.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sezımdık aqparatty tüsındırude midyñ nege negızgı röl atqaratynyn tüsındırıñız.

##### Sezım müşesın qabyldaityn aqparatymen bailanystyru

[relateASenseOrganToTheInformationItDetects.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/sensoryOrgansAndTheNervousSystem/relateASenseOrganToTheInformationItDetects.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate light, sound, smell, taste, and touch to receptors capable of detecting those signals.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Är sezım müşesın özı qabyldai alatyn aqparat türlerımen säikestendırıñız.

#### Tırek jäne qozğalys

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/supportAndMovement/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Bones provide support and levers, muscles exert force, and joints determine the possible directions of movement.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Süiekter, būlşyqetter men buyndar bırıgıp qozğalysty qalai qamtamasyz etetının zertteñız.

##### Süiekter men būlşyqetterdıñ özara äreketın sipattau

[describeInteractionsBetweenBonesAndMuscles.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/supportAndMovement/describeInteractionsBetweenBonesAndMuscles.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain movement at a joint through muscle attachments to bones and the interaction of muscles acting in opposite directions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Būlşyqetter süiekterdı tartyp, buyndardy qalai qozğaitynyn tüsınıñız.

##### Būlşyqetterdıñ qozğalystağy rölın tüsındıru

[explainTheRoleOfMusclesInMovement.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/supportAndMovement/explainTheRoleOfMusclesInMovement.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate contraction of muscle tissue to the generation of force that changes the positions of body parts.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Būlşyqetterdıñ jiyryluyn qozğalysqa qajettı küşpen bailanystyryñyz.

##### Qañqanyñ rölın tüsındıru

[explainTheRoleOfTheSkeleton.ts](../../../data/skills/humanAnatomyAndPhysiology/supportAndMovement/explainTheRoleOfTheSkeleton.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Show how bones maintain body shape and provide some protection to internal organs.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qañqa denenı qalai tırep, keibır müşelerdı qorğaitynyn tüsındırıñız.

### Mikrobiologia

Groups: 0 · Skills: 9

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/microbiology/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Microscopic cellular life forms and their processes, including bacteria, fermentation, decomposition, and interactions with the human body. Microscopic size does not define a single taxon; this Domain considers the shared context of microbial processes.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Mikroskopialyq jasuşaly ağzalardyñ aluan türlılıgın jäne olardyñ tabiğattağy ärı adam ıs-äreketındegı rölın zertteñız.

#### Bakterialar men arheialardy ajyratu

[distinguishBacteriaAndArchaea.ts](../../../data/skills/microbiology/distinguishBacteriaAndArchaea.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain that bacteria and archaea are separate evolutionary lineages of cellular organisms without a membrane-bound nucleus; molecular structural differences, including membrane lipids and cell envelopes, cannot be reduced to external cell shape.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bakterialar men arheialardy jasuşaly ağzalardyñ ekı bölek toby retınde ajyratyñyz.

#### Mikroorganizmderdıñ adammen paidaly jäne ziandy özara ärekettesuın ajyratu

[distinguishBeneficialAndHarmfulMicrobialInteractionsWithHumans.ts](../../../data/skills/microbiology/distinguishBeneficialAndHarmfulMicrobialInteractionsWithHumans.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish normal, beneficial, and potentially disease-causing interactions according to the microorganism, host, and conditions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Mikroorganizmder men adamdar arasyndağy paidaly, ziansyz jäne ziandy özara ärekettesulerdı ajyratyñyz.

#### Bakteria jasuşasynyñ bölınuın tüsındıru

[explainBacterialCellDivision.ts](../../../data/skills/microbiology/explainBacterialCellDivision.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain bacterial binary fission through replication of genetic material and formation of daughter cells, without confusing it with eukaryotic mitosis.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bakteria jasuşalarynyñ ekıge bölınu arqyly qalai köbeietının tüsındırıñız.

#### Prokariot jasuşasynyñ qūrylysyn tüsındıru

[explainProkaryoticCellStructure.ts](../../../data/skills/microbiology/explainProkaryoticCellStructure.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the organization of bacterial and archaeal cells without a membrane-bound nucleus and the roles of the membrane, cytoplasm, genetic material, and ribosomes; distinguish prokaryotic from eukaryotic cell organization.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bakterialar men arheialardyñ jasuşalary membranamen qorşalğan iadrosyz qalai jūmys ısteitının zertteñız.

#### Mikroorganizmderdıñ aşytudağy rölın tüsındıru

[explainTheRoleOfMicroorganismsInFermentation.ts](../../../data/skills/microbiology/explainTheRoleOfMicroorganismsInFermentation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate microbial transformations of sugars to the production of new products in food technologies.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Mikroorganizmderdıñ aşytu kezınde tağam qūramyn qalai özgertetının tüsındırıñız.

#### Mikroorganizmderdıñ ydyratudağy rölın tüsındıru

[explainTheirRoleInDecomposition.ts](../../../data/skills/microbiology/explainTheirRoleInDecomposition.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Show how bacteria and other microorganisms break down organic residues and return substances to circulation.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Mikroskopialyq ağzalardyñ ölı organikalyq zattardy qalai ydyratatynyn zertteñız.

#### Bakterialardyñ mekendeu ortasyn anyqtau

[identifyBacterialHabitats.ts](../../../data/skills/microbiology/identifyBacterialHabitats.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use examples to explain why bacteria occur in soil, water, organisms, and even extreme environments.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bakterialar nelıkten san aluan ortada ömır süre alatynyn bılıñız.

#### Mikroorganizmderdı sipattamasy boiynşa tanu

[recognizeMicroorganismsFromDescriptions.ts](../../../data/skills/microbiology/recognizeMicroorganismsFromDescriptions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish microscopic scale from taxonomic membership: bacteria, unicellular eukaryotes, and other organisms may all be very small.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Türlı toptağy köptegen ağzalar mikroskopialyq boluy mümkın ekenın tüsınıñız.

#### Mikroskopialyq eukariottardy tanu

[recognizeMicroscopicEukaryotes.ts](../../../data/skills/microbiology/recognizeMicroscopicEukaryotes.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize nucleated unicellular eukaryotes, including diverse protists, algae, and yeasts; do not treat 'microorganisms' as a single biological taxon.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jasuşasynda iadrosy bar mikroskopialyq ağzalardy tanyñyz.

### Mikologia

Groups: 0 · Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/mycology/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Fungi as a distinct branch of cellular life: nutrition, mycelium, fruiting bodies, and the role of fungi in matter cycling. Microscopic fungi overlap with Microbiology in scale, but their structure and biological characteristics are central here.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sañyrauqūlaqtardyñ qūrylysyn, qorektenuın jäne zat ainalymyndağy rölın zertteñız.

#### Mitselii men jemıstı denenı ajyratu

[distinguishMyceliumFromAFruitingBody.ts](../../../data/skills/mycology/distinguishMyceliumFromAFruitingBody.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why an underground or concealed network of hyphae forms the main body of many fungi, while the visible mushroom cap is only a reproductive structure.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sañyrauqūlaqtyñ jasyryn mitseliiı körınetın jemıstı deneden qalai erekşelenetının bılıñız.

#### Sañyrauqūlaqtardyñ organikalyq qaldyqtardy ydyratudağy rölın tüsındıru

[explainTheRoleOfFungiInDecomposingOrganicRemains.ts](../../../data/skills/mycology/explainTheRoleOfFungiInDecomposingOrganicRemains.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate enzymes secreted by fungi to the breakdown of remains and the reuse of substances in an ecosystem.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sañyrauqūlaqtar organikalyq qaldyqtardy ydyratyp, zattardy ekojüielerge qalai qaitaratynyn tüsındırıñız.

#### Sañyrauqūlaq jemıstı denesınıñ negızgı bölıkterın anyqtau

[identifyTheMainPartsOfAMushroomFruitingBody.ts](../../../data/skills/mycology/identifyTheMainPartsOfAMushroomFruitingBody.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Locate the cap, stalk, and spore-producing structures on a diagram of a typical cap-and-stalk mushroom.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kädımgı sañyrauqūlaqtyñ qalpağyn, sabağyn jäne spora tüzetın bölıkterın anyqtañyz.

#### Sañyrauqūlaqtardy ağzalardyñ bölek toby retınde tanu

[recognizeFungiAsADistinctGroupOfOrganisms.ts](../../../data/skills/mycology/recognizeFungiAsADistinctGroupOfOrganisms.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish fungi, plants, and animals by how they obtain organic substances and by structural characteristics.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sañyrauqūlaqtardy ösımdıkter men januarlardan qorektenu täsılı jäne qūrylysy boiynşa ajyratyñyz.

### Virusologia

Groups: 0 · Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/virology/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Viruses as noncellular infectious agents: structure, reproduction inside host cells, and routes of transmission. They are not cellular organisms, although they are studied alongside them.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Virustardyñ ne ekenın, olardyñ iesınıñ jasuşalarynda qalai köbeietının jäne qalai taralatynyn bıl.

#### Virusty jasuşaly ağzadan ajyratu

[distinguishAVirusFromACellularOrganism.ts](../../../data/skills/virology/distinguishAVirusFromACellularOrganism.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare cellular organisms' cell membranes, cytoplasm, and independent metabolism with the absence of this cellular organization in a virus particle.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Virustardyñ jasuşalardan tūratyn ağzalardan qalai erekşelenetının tüsın.

#### Virustyñ berılu joldaryn tüsındıru

[explainMechanismsOfViralTransmission.ts](../../../data/skills/virology/explainMechanismsOfViralTransmission.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how viruses spread between hosts by different routes, including respiratory particles, contact, biological fluids, vectors, and other mechanisms, and why a particular route depends on the characteristics of the virus and its hosts.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Virustardyñ bır iesınen ekınşı iesıne berıluınıñ ärtürlı joldaryn salystyr.

#### Virustyñ ne ekenın tüsındıru

[explainWhatAVirusIs.ts](../../../data/skills/virology/explainWhatAVirusIs.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain that a virus is a noncellular infectious agent containing genetic material; it lacks its own protein-synthesis machinery and reproduces using a host cell.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Nelıkten virustarğa jaña virustar tüzu üşın tırı jasuşalar qajet ekenın tüsındır.

### Zoologia

Groups: 4 · Skills: 28

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Comparison of major animal groups, relationships between structure and function, feeding patterns, development, and behavior. Food chains and interspecies networks as whole systems belong to Ecology.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Januarlardyñ qūrylysy, qozğalysy, ösuı jäne mınez-qūlqy jağynan qalai erekşelenetının bıl.

#### Januarlar aluandyğy

Skills: 17

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identifying major animal groups requires diagnostic characteristics, including skeletal structure, body coverings, limbs, and developmental patterns, rather than incidental external resemblance.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Januarlardyñ negızgı toptaryn syrtqy ūqsastyğyna ğana emes, dene qūrylysynyñ senımdı belgılerıne qarap tany.

##### Omyrtqalylar men omyrtqasyzdardy ajyratu

[distinguishVertebratesAndInvertebrates.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/distinguishVertebratesAndInvertebrates.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use the presence of a vertebral column as the anatomical dividing line between these two broad groups.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Omyrtqa jotasy bar januarlardy omyrtqasy joq januarlardan ajyrat.

##### Qosmekendılerdıñ belgılerın tanu

[recognizeAmphibianCharacteristics.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/recognizeAmphibianCharacteristics.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify characteristic features of a group in which development is often associated with water and adults may use lungs and skin for respiration.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qosmekendıler men olardyñ damuyna tän ortaq belgılerdı tany.

##### Buyltyq qūrttardyñ belgılerın tanu

[recognizeAnnelidCharacteristics.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/recognizeAnnelidCharacteristics.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the segmented body of annelids and distinguish them from nematodes and flatworms, even where all these animals have similarly elongated bodies.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Denesı buyltyqtarğa bölıngen qūrttardy tanyp, olardy basqa qūrttärızdı januarlardan ajyrat.

##### Örmekşıtärızdılerdıñ belgılerın tanu

[recognizeArachnidCharacteristics.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/recognizeArachnidCharacteristics.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize arthropods with characteristic chelicerae and usually four pairs of walking legs in adults; distinguish spiders, ticks and mites, and scorpions from insects.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Örmekşıler men basqa örmekşıtärızdılerdı dene qūrylysynyñ erekşe belgılerı arqyly tany.

##### Qūstardyñ belgılerın tanu

[recognizeBirdCharacteristics.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/recognizeBirdCharacteristics.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use feathers as the primary diagnostic characteristic of birds, regardless of their ability to fly.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qūstardy ūşa almasa da qauyrsyndary arqyly tany.

##### Işekquystylardyñ belgılerın tanu

[recognizeCnidarianCharacteristics.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/recognizeCnidarianCharacteristics.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize cnidarians by stinging cells and the characteristic body plans of polyps and medusae; do not regard the medusa form as obligatory for every member.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Meduzalar men marjandardy olardyñ atpa jasuşalary arqyly tany.

##### Jergılıktı keñ taralğan januarlardy tanu

[recognizeCommonLocalAnimals.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/recognizeCommonLocalAnimals.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify familiar local species from a characteristic combination of body structure, coverings, and modes of movement.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tanys januarlardy dene qūrylysy men dene jabynynyñ erekşe belgılerı arqyly anyqta.

##### Şaiantärızdılerdıñ belgılerın tanu

[recognizeCrustaceanCharacteristics.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/recognizeCrustaceanCharacteristics.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize diverse crustaceans by jointed appendages, antennae, and characteristic structural traits; do not treat ten legs as a universal characteristic of crustaceans.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Barlyq şaiantärızdılerdıñ on aiağy bolady dep eseptemei, olardyñ aluan türlı dene qūrylysyn tany.

##### Tıkenterılılerdıñ belgılerın tanu

[recognizeEchinodermCharacteristics.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/recognizeEchinodermCharacteristics.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify marine invertebrates with a water vascular system and characteristic adult symmetry, distinguishing sea stars, sea urchins, and other representatives.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Teñız jūldyzdary men basqa tıkenterılılerdı erekşe dene qūrylysy arqyly anyqta.

##### Balyqtardyñ belgılerın tanu

[recognizeFishCharacteristics.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/recognizeFishCharacteristics.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify typical traits of aquatic vertebrates with gill respiration and fins while accounting for the diversity of fish.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Balyqtardyñ aluandyğyn eskere otyryp, olardyñ tän belgılerın anyqta.

##### Jalpaq qūrttardyñ belgılerın tanu

[recognizeFlatwormCharacteristics.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/recognizeFlatwormCharacteristics.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the flattened body and other features of flatworms, including free-living and parasitic forms, without confusing them with annelids.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jalpaq qūrttardy tanyp, olardy buyltyq qūrttardan ajyrat.

##### Bunaqdenelılerdıñ belgılerın tanu

[recognizeInsectCharacteristics.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/recognizeInsectCharacteristics.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify six legs, three main body regions, and other characteristic features of adult insects.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bunaqdenelılerdı alty aiağy men denesınıñ üş negızgı bölımı boiynşa tany.

##### Sütqorektılerdıñ belgılerın tanu

[recognizeMammalCharacteristics.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/recognizeMammalCharacteristics.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify members by mammary glands and characteristic body coverings without assuming that every mammal gives birth to live young.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Barlyq sütqorektıler tırı töl tuady dep oilamai, olardy aiqyndaityn belgılerı arqyly tany.

##### Bylqyldaqdenelılerdıñ belgılerın tanu

[recognizeMolluscCharacteristics.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/recognizeMolluscCharacteristics.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the soft body, mantle, and other characteristic features of gastropods, bivalves, and cephalopods, taking into account that not all molluscs have an external shell.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bylqyldaqdenelılerdı jūmsaq denesı men basqa tän qūrylymdary arqyly anyqta.

##### Jūmyr qūrttardyñ belgılerın tanu

[recognizeNematodeCharacteristics.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/recognizeNematodeCharacteristics.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the unsegmented elongated bodies of roundworms and features of their lifestyles, including free-living and parasitic forms.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jūmyr qūrttardy buyltyqtarğa bölınbegen denesı men basqa belgılerı arqyly tany.

##### Bauyrymen jorğalauşylardyñ belgılerın tanu

[recognizeReptileCharacteristics.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/recognizeReptileCharacteristics.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify members by characteristics of scaled skin and reproductive features of terrestrial amniotes.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bauyrymen jorğalauşylardyñ terısı men köbeiuıne qatysty belgılerın anyqta.

##### Gubkalardyñ belgılerın tanu

[recognizeSpongeCharacteristics.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/animalDiversity/recognizeSpongeCharacteristics.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the porous body structure and filter-feeding of sponges, explaining that they lack true tissues and organs.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Gubkalardy keuektı denesı men sudy süzu arqyly qorektenu täsılıne qarap tany.

#### Januarlardyñ mınez-qūlqy

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/behavior/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Animal actions arise in response to signals and needs; observation makes it possible to identify defense, communication, and benefits of living in groups.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Januarlardyñ mınez-qūlqy qarym-qatynasqa, qorğanuğa jäne top bolyp ömır süruge qalai kömektesetının bıl.

##### Toptyq mınez-qūlyqtyñ paidasyn tüsındıru

[explainBenefitsOfGroupBehavior.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/behavior/explainBenefitsOfGroupBehavior.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how cooperative foraging, defense, or care for offspring may improve the success of individuals.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Toptyq mınez-qūlyq januarlarğa qorek tabuğa, qorğanuğa jäne tölderın kütuge qalai kömektesetının bıl.

##### Januarlar qarym-qatynasyndağy signaldardyñ rölın tüsındıru

[explainTheRoleOfSignalsInAnimalCommunication.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/behavior/explainTheRoleOfSignalsInAnimalCommunication.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate sound, smell, movement, or coloration to information received by another individual.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Januarlardyñ dybystar, qimyldar jäne basqa signaldar arqyly qalai bailanysatynyn tüsındır.

##### Qorğanu mınez-qūlqyn tanu

[recognizeDefensiveBehavior.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/behavior/recognizeDefensiveBehavior.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine whether fleeing, freezing, distraction, or attacking reduces a threat in a given situation.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qauıp töngen kezde januarlar körsetetın mınez-qūlyqty tany.

#### Qorektenu jäne damu

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/nutritionAndDevelopment/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Food sources differ among animal groups, while their life cycles may involve body transformations or development without a drastic change in form.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Januarlardyñ qorektenuı men tırşılık tsiklderınıñ qalai erekşelenetının bıl.

##### Januarlardy qorektenuıne qarai jıkteu

[classifyAnimalsByDiet.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/nutritionAndDevelopment/classifyAnimalsByDiet.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Classify examples as herbivores, carnivores, or omnivores according to actual diets rather than animal names.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Januarlardy şyn mänınde jeitın qoregıne qarai jıkte.

##### Metamorfozben jäne onsyz damudy salystyru

[compareDevelopmentWithAndWithoutMetamorphosis.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/nutritionAndDevelopment/compareDevelopmentWithAndWithoutMetamorphosis.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare life cycles involving radical structural change with cycles in which young individuals resemble adults.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Damu barysynda dene qūrylysy kürt özgeretın januarlardy mūndai kürt özgerıske ūşyramaityndarmen salystyr.

##### Jas jäne eresek januarlardy ajyratu

[distinguishJuvenilesAndAdults.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/nutritionAndDevelopment/distinguishJuvenilesAndAdults.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine an individual’s developmental stage by body proportions, coverings, or reproductive maturity.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jas jäne eresek januarlardyñ aiyrmaşylyqtaryn tany.

##### Bunaqdenelılerdıñ tolyq türlenuın tüsındıru

[explainCompleteMetamorphosisInInsects.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/nutritionAndDevelopment/explainCompleteMetamorphosisInInsects.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain the four developmental stages of insects with complete metamorphosis: egg, larva, pupa, and imago; using butterflies, beetles, or flies as examples, distinguish the markedly different functions and structures of larvae and adults.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bunaqdenelılerdıñ tolyq türlenuındegı jūmyrtqa, dernäsıl, quyrşaq jäne eresek kezeñderın baqyla.

#### Qūrylysy men qyzmetterı

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/structureAndFunctions/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The forms of limbs, body coverings, and sensory structures are explained by their roles in locomotion, orientation, and protection against danger.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Dene qūrylysy januarlardyñ qozğaluyna, ainalany sezınuıne jäne qorğanuyna qalai kömektesetının zertte.

##### Mınez-qūlyqtağy sezım müşelerınıñ rölın tüsındıru

[explainTheRoleOfSensoryOrgansInBehavior.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/structureAndFunctions/explainTheRoleOfSensoryOrgansInBehavior.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect perception of sounds, smells, light, or vibrations with orientation and finding food.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sezım müşelerı januarlarğa qorek tabuğa jäne bağdarlanuğa qalai kömektesetının bıl.

##### Januarlardyñ qorğanyş beiımdelulerın anyqtau

[identifyProtectiveAdaptationsInAnimals.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/structureAndFunctions/identifyProtectiveAdaptationsInAnimals.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the function of camouflage, shells or armor, spines, and other defensive structures in particular situations.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Januarlardyñ qorğanuyna kömektesetın dene qūrylymdaryn tany.

##### Dene jabyndaryn olardyñ qyzmetımen bailanystyru

[relateBodyCoveringsToTheirFunctions.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/structureAndFunctions/relateBodyCoveringsToTheirFunctions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how feathers, fur, scales, and skin provide protection, thermal insulation, or water balance.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jün, qauyrsyn, qabyrşaq jäne terı januarlardyñ denesın qalai qorğaitynyn tüsındır.

##### Aiaq-qol qūrylysynyñ qozğalyspen bailanysyn anyqtau

[relateLimbStructureToLocomotion.ts](../../../data/skills/zoology/structureAndFunctions/relateLimbStructureToLocomotion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate the shape of legs, fins, or wings to the requirements of walking, swimming, digging, or flying.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Aiaq-qol pışının jüru, jüzu, qazu nemese ūşumen bailanystyr.
